data: Synthetic fixtures only; never open personal archives or source logs.

requirements.contract: Persistent summaries exactly match message counts, recency and deletion semantics across restart, rollback and external writers.
Reuse only verified minimal artifacts; rebuild after source, assets, dependency or mode changes; preserve environment and argv.
Session content and source fingerprints commit or roll back together; unchanged sessions stay skipped.
Worker imports stage bounded normalized records, perform one additive atomic merge and retain snapshot/audit safeguards.
Materialized last-message dates and counts preserve ordering and live bridge precedence.
Read messages once; compact IPC retains every alternate branch and the exact current path.
Defer heavy chat dependencies and virtualize Message Map without dropping rows, formatting, highlights or navigation.
requirements.environment: isolated Electron/Xvfb; actual Wayland manual check also required

requirements.contract: Cancel superseded work only for its caller; bounded workers/cache preserve rank, date sorting, role filters and exact totals.
Async local assets and in-flight image dedup retain independent response bodies, access checks and invalidation; caches are byte bounded.
Stream verification with identical JSON/hash-chain/tamper checks and complete record counts.
Bound header reads, normalize once and pack traceback while preserving positional changes and add-before-remove LCS ties.
